instruction: A koi fish cut like a single enormous gemstone, its body a lattice of sharp brilliant facets in deep ruby fading to clear white toward the tail. Flowing fins are thin faceted blades that refract light into small rainbow flares, and the round eyes are polished cabochon domes of dark garnet. Internal reflections scatter red sparks through the translucent belly.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Faceted Crystal Koi in a gemstone-faceted style. A koi fish cut like a single enormous gemstone, its body a lattice of sharp brilliant facets in deep ruby fading to clear white toward the tail. Flowing fins are thin faceted blades that refract light into small rainbow flares, and the round eyes are polished cabochon domes of dark garnet. Internal reflections scatter red sparks through the translucent belly. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
